plain: To slow down or block the way of something

webster.text: To hinder; to stop in progress; to obstruct; as, to impede the progress of troops.

example.quote: It would be contrary to the spirit of the Constitution to impede the operations of the government, perhaps at a critical period.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 14, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
